scope: isolated local user-systemd validation; production port 1991 was not modified

scenarios.name: unified managed and anonymous restart
details: one anonymous and one managed dynamic runtime wrote separate mode-0600 manifests
the runtime manifest was authoritative while the managed registry retained the documented one-release rc.15 rollback projection
manager restart retained both runtime IDs, replaced all VNC/server/gateway PIDs, and restored both gateways healthy
explicit anonymous stop and managed desiredState=stopped removed both active manifests

scenarios.name: pre-manifest fixed autostart migration
details: a fixed display :13 runtime retained its VNC/server/gateway units while its manifest was deliberately removed to model rc.15
startup stopped only the exact legacy runtime units, removed its runtime directory, and preserved profile data
template autostart created a new healthy runtime on :13, RFB 5913, and gateway 39013
all old units were inactive and the manager did not enter a restart loop

scenarios.name: exact rc.15 rollback and roll-forward
details: the immutable GitHub v0.1.0-rc.15 Linux artifact had a different remotexappd SHA-256 from the working candidate
rc.15 loaded the managed compatibility projection and retained runtime ID plus all three VNC/server/gateway PIDs
rolling forward to the candidate retained the runtime ID, replaced all three unit PIDs, and restored a healthy gateway
the unified manifest remained authoritative for the candidate while rc.15 ignored it safely

scenarios.name: abrupt manager SIGKILL with healthy anonymous runtime
details: the active anonymous runtime manifest was mode 0600 before fault injection
all VNC/server/gateway units remained active after SIGKILL
restart retained runtime ID mousepad-a889c54bc229 while replacing all three unit PIDs and returning server-ready
explicit forced stop removed the manifest

scenarios.name: crash during partial runtime creation
details: fault injection left runtime partial-start-613874e31133 with a starting manifest, active VNC unit, and inactive server unit
restart stopped the old VNC process and recreated the same runtime ID from the corrected current template
the recovered VNC PID differed and server plus gateway units became healthy
explicit forced stop removed the manifest and isolated test resources

scenarios.name: local fixed XFCE browser and cold restart
details: the candidate ran only on loopback port 2096 with fixed display :15; production port 1991 and displays :1/:2 were unchanged
real headless Chrome connected through the SDK/noVNC stack and kept the 1280x720 framebuffer while scaling CSS from 776.875x437 to 900x506.25
finite reconnect exhausted exactly once after two attempts, unlimited reconnect did not exhaust after five injected failures, and explicit reconnect reset the budget
manager restart retained runtime ID xfce-user-validation-a4ab01f6bb90, replaced all four unit PIDs, and the browser reattached to a running generation
the legacy observe-reconnect harness lost its CDP response while collecting final events, but an independent browser check confirmed connected RFB/input channels after restart
XFCE logout reported exited and disconnected without automatic reconnect; explicit reconnect started healthy generation 2

scenarios.name: local Mousepad graceful-shutdown browser path
details: real Chrome delivered Local ASCII plus Chinese text with a 2 ms round trip and a focused remote caret
an unsaved document made graceful stop return HTTP 409 while preserving the connected session
forced stop disconnected the viewer, removed the manifest, and left session/gateway/server/VNC units inactive
managed XFCE desiredState=stopped removed its manifest and all four units before test cleanup

cleanup: all isolated managers, runtime units, listeners, configurations, and temporary state roots were removed
